passage_parts.label: A
passage_parts.title: Let's Keep Our Uniforms
passage_parts.text: Many students want to wear whatever they like to school, but I believe school uniforms are worth keeping. First, they save time. Every morning, I simply put on my uniform instead of standing in front of my closet, wondering what to wear. Second, uniforms save money. My parents buy a few sets at the start of the school year, and that is all I need. Without uniforms, many students might feel they must buy fashionable clothes to fit in. Third, uniforms make us feel that we belong to the same school. When our class wears them on school trips, people can tell at once where we come from, and our teachers can find us quickly in a crowd. Some students complain that uniforms are uncomfortable, but this problem can be solved. Our school already lets us wear sports uniforms for gym classes and our own warm coats on cold days. In my view, we should improve our uniforms, not get rid of them.

passage_parts.label: B
passage_parts.title: Let Us Choose What We Wear
passage_parts.text: Supporters of uniforms say they save time and money, but I see things differently. My uniform shirt is too thin in winter and too hot in summer, and the skirt makes it hard to run or sit on the floor during club activities. Clothes should help us learn, not get in our way. I am also tired of the uniform checks at the school gate. In Taiwan, schools are no longer allowed to give students a demerit just for not wearing the right clothes, yet some teachers still spend the first minutes of the day checking what we wear. That time could be used for learning. Besides, choosing my own clothes lets me show who I am, and learning to dress well for different situations is a useful skill for adult life. I am not saying uniforms should disappear completely. We could wear them for ceremonies and other formal events and choose our own clothes on other days. After all, students should have a say in rules that affect them every day.

options.A: How to dress warmly on cold school days.
options.B: Why students' names were taken off their uniforms.

options.B: The time students spend choosing what to wear.

questions.stem: Which idea do both writers agree with?

options.A: Uniforms help students' families save a lot of money.
options.B: Uniforms do not have to be given up completely.
options.C: Students should wear their own clothes every day.
options.D: Teachers should stop checking uniforms at the gate.

1.explanation_zh: 文本 A 的作者認為制服值得保留，列出省時、省錢、有歸屬感三個理由；文本 B 的作者認為學生應該能自己選衣服。兩篇是針對「學生該不該穿制服」的正反意見。
evidence: Many students want to wear whatever they like to school, but I believe school uniforms are worth keeping.
Supporters of uniforms say they save time and money, but I see things differently.

option_notes_zh.A: 冷天穿外套只是文本 A 末尾的一個細節。
option_notes_zh.B: 兩篇都沒有提到把名字從制服上拿掉。
option_notes_zh.C: 校門口的服裝檢查只是文本 B 的一個理由，沒有涵蓋文本 A。

1.strategy_zh: 多文本主旨題要找兩篇共同討論的議題；先看兩篇的第一句各自表達什麼立場。
hints: 文本 A 第一句的立場是什麼？
文本 B 第一句說 I see things differently，作者不同意什麼？
兩篇共同在討論的問題是什麼？

2.explanation_zh: 文本 A 說全班穿制服校外教學時，別人一眼就看得出他們從哪裡來，老師也能在人群中很快找到他們。
evidence: When our class wears them on school trips, people can tell at once where we come from, and our teachers can find us quickly in a crowd.

option_notes_zh.A: 文本 B 說裙子讓人很難跑步、坐在地上，這是制服的缺點，不是文本 A 說的好處。
option_notes_zh.B: 「學會為成年生活得體穿著」是文本 B 支持自己選衣服的理由，文本 A 沒有這樣說；要分清楚是哪一篇的論點。
option_notes_zh.D: 文本 A 說冷天可以穿自己的保暖外套，並沒有說不必帶外套，也和校外教學無關。

2.strategy_zh: 題幹限定 Text A 和 school trips，先到文本 A 找 school trips，再比對選項；其他選項常是另一篇的內容。
hints: 在文本 A 找 school trips。
那一句說別人和老師可以怎樣？
B 的內容出現在哪一篇？是誰的論點？

3.explanation_zh: 前一句說有些老師每天一開始還是花好幾分鐘檢查學生穿什麼，接著說 That time 本來可以用來學習，所以 That time 指老師檢查服裝花掉的時間。
evidence: In Taiwan, schools are no longer allowed to give students a demerit just for not wearing the right clothes, yet some teachers still spend the first minutes of the day checking what we wear.
That time could be used for learning.

option_notes_zh.B: 站在衣櫃前想穿什麼是文本 A 作者說的，不在文本 B 這一句之前，代回去也不合文意。
option_notes_zh.C: 社團活動在文本 B 前面提到，但那是說裙子不方便，和「本來可以用來學習的時間」無關。
option_notes_zh.D: 典禮在文本 B 後面才出現，而且作者主張典禮時仍穿制服。

3.strategy_zh: 指示詞 That＋名詞通常指前一句剛提到的事；找前一句和「時間」有關的內容。
hints: 粗體 That time 在文本 B 的哪裡？先讀前一句。
前一句說老師每天一開始花時間做什麼？
把它代回 ___ could be used for learning，通不通？

4.explanation_zh: 文本 A 說應該改良制服，而不是廢除；文本 B 說並不是主張制服完全消失，典禮時仍可穿。兩位作者都認為制服不必完全廢除。
evidence: In my view, we should improve our uniforms, not get rid of them.
I am not saying uniforms should disappear completely.

option_notes_zh.A: 只有文本 A 說制服省錢；文本 B 不同意這個說法。
option_notes_zh.C: 文本 B 主張典禮以外的日子自己選衣服，並不是每天；文本 A 也不同意。
option_notes_zh.D: 只有文本 B 抱怨校門口的服裝檢查。

4.strategy_zh: 「兩篇都同意」的題目，每個選項都要回到兩篇各找一次；只出現在一篇，或另一篇明確反對的，就刪掉。
hints: 兩篇的最後幾句各自怎麼說？
文本 A 的 not get rid of them 和文本 B 的 not ... disappear completely 意思一樣嗎？
其他選項各是哪一篇的論點？

translation_zh.text:
文本 A　保留我們的制服吧
很多學生想穿自己喜歡的衣服上學，但我認為校服值得保留。第一，校服節省時間。每天早上，我只要穿上制服，不必站在衣櫃前煩惱要穿什麼。第二，校服省錢。我爸媽在學年開始時買幾套，我就夠穿了。如果沒有校服，很多學生可能會覺得一定要買時髦的衣服才能融入大家。第三，校服讓我們覺得自己屬於同一所學校。我們班穿著制服校外教學時，別人一眼就看得出我們從哪裡來，老師也能在人群中很快找到我們。有些學生抱怨制服不舒服，但這個問題可以解決。我們學校已經讓我們上體育課時穿運動服，冷天時可以穿自己的保暖外套。依我看，我們應該改良制服，而不是廢除它。
文本 B　讓我們自己選擇穿什麼
支持制服的人說制服省時又省錢，但我的看法不同。我的制服襯衫冬天太薄、夏天太熱，裙子也讓我在社團活動時很難跑步或坐在地上。衣服應該幫助我們學習，而不是妨礙我們。我也厭倦了校門口的服裝檢查。在台灣，學校已經不能只因為學生沒穿規定的服裝就記過，但有些老師每天一開始還是花好幾分鐘檢查我們穿什麼。那段時間本來可以用來學習。此外，自己選衣服讓我能展現自己，而學會在不同場合得體地穿著，也是成年生活中有用的技能。我並不是說制服應該完全消失。我們可以在典禮和其他正式場合穿制服，其他日子則自己選擇服裝。畢竟，學生對於每天影響自己的規定應該有發言權。

open_tasks.prompt: Write one English sentence that tells the main idea of the passage.

The two writers disagree about uniforms, but neither of them wants to get rid of uniforms completely.
